data.title: Solving Systems of Linear Equations by Graphing
data.description: Practice finding the solution to a system of two linear equations by visually reading the intersection point from a coordinate plane.

challenges.instruction: Look at the two lines on the graph. Find the intersection point and enter (x, y).
challenges.hint: Trace each line to where they cross. From the origin, count across for x, then up or down for y. Then check the pair in both equations.
